notes.title: Couch Co-Op Fest: Here we come!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623760/51db8ce52bad91a2f9a5985071010f6c384d9703.png

Hello you beautiful people!

It's been a while since our last update here on steam, but just know, we are still hard working on the game!

With the Steam Couch Co-op Fest around the corner, we thought we'd give you a bit of an update on what we've been working on last year:


Skills and store: get new skill and upgrade them in the store!
Shell selection: select which shell to use in combat
Fragility: instead of braking, the shell now becomes fragile. Don't get hit again!
Objectives: each sub level has a small objective, which gives you sea-stars. Get them all to unlock skills!
Shared Objectives: co-op mode? hehe, right on theme! we got you covered with shared objectives and skills.
Seastars: use them to buy new skills
New overworld: a whole new level!
New UI: complete overwhole of the UI
Multi-Player UI: UI that accomodates co-op.
Game progression Event: new fancy animations with caracters talking to you!
Game Recap: how did the level go for you?
Hook Timer: lose and gain time on the hook depending on your actions.
Add new attacks to Electric Eel and Murena: a whole new skill-set for the two bosses!
Inside Murena: attack the Murena from inside.
New Biome: we got started on a new biome.
Biome Switcher: switch between biomes, discover a whole new region.
Armor: some monsters now have armor, only certain shells are efficient against that!
New Smol Eel: better smol eel animation!
Pollution/Ink: cool effects, the enemies and Hermit disappear in the ink/pollution!
Temporary Health: get some temporary upgrades, they are only good until you lose them.
Pickup Plankton: you now have to collect the plankton!
Hammer redirect: didn't time it right? redirect the hammer smash a bit.
Summon: summon new shells, ask Bromedes for help!


Not all of this is in the Demo, some might come to it in a bit, but if you'd like to get semi-regular updates, follow us on these platforms:
Youtube: @earlycoffeegames
TikTok: @earlycoffeegames
Bluesky: @earlycoffee.games
Instagram: @earlycoffeegames
Threads: @earlycoffeegames
mastodon: @earlycoffeegames@mastodon.gamedev.place

Wishlist and follow!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1773740

notes.title: New Hermit Demo Out! Right on time for Steam Remote Play Together Fest!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623760/70cb13e81f84c0805d079173afcbfb3d84a418f7.png

Hello you beautiful people!

We have some amazing news!

We have been hard at work to create a new version of the Demo, more accessible, more fun to play, and with more content than ever before!

The new Demo includes:

 Tutorial, brought to you by Bromedes the turtle! 🐢
 Mini levels, featuring crabs! 🦀
 Objectives, unlocking starfish! ⭐️
 One boss level, with a giant crab!
 An infinite level with steam leaderboards to measure your skills against your friends!
 Skill upgrades shop
 Shell upgrades shop
 Three languages: English, French and German!


We made sure the demo is live for the Steam Remote Play Together Fest, which starts Monday!

We hope you enjoy playing the demo as much as we enjoyed creating it!

Wishlist and follow!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1773740

notes.title: Hermit: an Underwater Tale Demo Available for Free Now!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the first public Demo of Hermit: an Underwater Tale
is now available for free to play for all!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623760/2ebb8e79089ac5b539decec32cd066feac0eb34c.png

The demo includes:

 A tutorial, and first easy level (ok ok maybe not that easy).
 A second challenging level.
 An infinite level, with leaderboards and high score. Try to beat your friends!
 No less than 6 different shells!
 Co-op mode, for a lot more fun!


We hope you will enjoy playing the Demo as much as we enjoyed creating it!

Early Coffee Games

Play the Demo!
